title: Algebraic Interaction: A Recipe for Neural Architecture Generation
abstract: arXiv:2611.18649v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We introduce an algebraic foundation for neural architecture design in which convolution, attention, state-space models, and equivariant layers are expressed through compositions of bilinear product operators over two structures: a position algebra governing positional routing and a feature algebra governing feature interactions. This decomposition makes routing, feature algebra, and operator composition explicit design variables.We focus on the feature-algebra axis through an Algebraic Recipe: fix the routing and operator composition of an existing architecture while replacing its feature algebra. This preserves the information-flow structure while allowing computational and symmetry properties to be modified through algebraic specification.We instantiate the recipe in linear attention, Mamba, and equivariant networks. translated_title: 代数交互：一种神经架构生成的配方
translated_abstract: 我们为神经架构设计引入了一个代数基础，其中卷积、注意力、状态空间模型和等变层通过双线性乘积算子的组合来表达，这些算子作用在两种结构之上：控制位置路由的位置代数和控制特征交互的特征代数。这种分解使路由、特征代数和算子组合成为显式的设计变量。我们通过一个“代数配方”专注于特征代数这一轴：固定现有架构的路由和算子组合，同时替换其特征代数。这在保留信息流结构的同时，允许通过代数规范来修改计算和对称性属性。我们在线性注意力、Mamba和等变网络中实例化了该配方。结构常数代数和Clifford代数在线性注意力中以相当的参数量提升了准确率；结构（摘要原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于位置代数与特征代数的神经架构设计代数框架，通过“代数配方”在保持路由和信息流结构不变的前提下仅替换特征代数，即可改进线性注意力、Mamba和等变网络的性能。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces an algebraic foundation for neural architecture design based on position and feature algebras, and proposes an "Algebraic Recipe" that improves linear attention, Mamba, and equivariant networks by replacing only the feature algebra while preserving the routing and information-flow structure.
